notes.title: Viking Frontiers: Prologue Hotfix #3
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, warriors! ✊[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
The gods blessed us with their grace and sent us the [b]inspiration to craft yet another Hotfix.[/b] You, dear Vikings, were also generous with your amazing feedback, thanks to which we were able to prepare [b]a number of changes and fixes[/b] ⚒️ Know, that we are very happy to see your commitment and warm welcome to the Prologue version and will do our best to further improve our title.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949212/d91a5096ed55bd2ab3bc4cc038ad8bc6fd16d489.png[/img]

[b]More fresh improvements and crucial fixes[/b] are just around the corner, so be sure to not miss out! We’d love to get your insights on the latest tweaks - to share them, join us on Discord or speak your mind on Steam Discussions. [b]Appreciate![/b]


[h2]Viking Frontiers: Prologue - Hotfix #3 notes:[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
• Improvements to the general interactions (blocking, detection of interactive objects, fast interaction executions)
• Disabling the character's stench symbol (fish bones) - this feature will be available in the full version of the game
• Dialogue options selected by the player do not appear a second time in a conversation with an NPC
• Fixes to the hammer animation while building
• Interaction UI does not disappear between hammer blows
• The "R" key now collects all available items from the stash

[h3]Thank you, Vikings! Until next time! 🖐️[/h3]

notes.title: Viking Frontiers: Prologue Playtest Hotfix 1.1.0p
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, warriors! ✊[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
A heartfelt thank you to all those who chose to try out the Viking Frontiers: Prologue Playest version! Thanks to your reports, suggestions and valuable feedback, our team was able to prepare [b]the first Hotfix,[/b] which addresses several important issues that you Vikings told us about.

Please know that each of your reports and ideas is carefully analyzed by our team, so we will be grateful for every piece of information you decide to share with us. The fastest and most convenient way to provide us with your opinion is to use this 👉 [url=https://forms.gle/DzAnif887ZMLLtcPA][b]dedicated Feedback Form.[/b][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949212/2c12e73b7ba4839203126f3592d0e1d8e84f4cb4.png[/img]

[h2]Hotfix 1.1.0p Notes:[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
• Fixed an issue with saving game progress
• Fixed a bug that caused cut trees to disappear underground
• Fixed rain behavior (raining inside the shipwreck)
• Added an option to bind mouse keys
• The settlers' needs and diseases system has been disabled
• Improved the effect of structure decals on logs

[b]Note:[/b] After updating the game, your saves may stop working. We apologize for the inconvenience!


[h2]Please note 🤔[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Keep in mind that this is only a [b]"work-in-progress"[/b] version of the game, the main goal of which is to present the overall concept of this project and its novelties. Remember, that at this stage you may encounter some bugs and problems, as the title is still in development. Viking Frontiers is sure to receive numerous patches, most of them based on your feedback, so please share your thoughts via our Discord server, Social Media or Steam.

[h3]Thank you, Vikings! Until next time! 🖐️[/h3]

notes.title: Viking Frontiers: Prologue Playtest is now LIVE 📣
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, warriors! ✊[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
And so, the saga unfolds once again. On this day, the Gods took their chosen ones and sent them into the uncharted, hostile wilderness that [b]they would now call home.[/b] Will they rebuild the power of their clan? Will they overcome the hardships of nature? And most importantly - will they survive? [b]It all depends on you[/b] - their honorable Jarl.


[h2]The Prologue Playtest has just started, and you can become our tester 🤩[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/76e4e79b5d9e4b11007f2465b80ed4e585d54d85.png[/img]

We are incredibly excited to announce that from now on, you can all enter our latest Steam Viking Frontiers Playtest. To do so, visit the [b]Viking Frontiers: Prologue Steam page[/b] and find the Playtest section (just above the announcements). Next, look for the green [b]Request Access button[/b] ✅, click it and... it's done! 

After requesting access, you should soon receive a message that you have been approved to Playtest. We will try to provide access to as many of you as possible. At the same time, we would like to point out that testers are selected randomly by the Steam panel.

We hope you are ready to take control of your clan's future and return to the majestic Nordic lands. This time, you will dive into the [b]new, enhanced and more refined version of Viking Frontiers[/b] for an even deeper and more thrilling experience. Explore, gather, build, craft, manage, and fight in the name of the Gods to prove yourself as one of [b]history’s greatest Viking leaders 👑[/b] Sounds amazing, right?


[h2]Your feedback is priceless 📜[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Please know that your feedback is very important to our entire team and that we remain at your disposal on our Discord server, Social Media channels and Steam Discussions. The fastest and most convenient way to provide us with your opinion is to use [url=https://forms.gle/7MJXoM3oKFUY2iJJ8][b]this dedicated Feedback Form.[/b][/url]

Every bit of information can be crucial, so we encourage you to share your thoughts on the Viking Frontiers: Prologue Playtest version!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949212/9d366b0ab11d77ab14698c14c63f58c64b10e0ec.gif[/img]


[h2]Please note 🤔[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Keep in mind that this is only a [b]"work-in-progress"[/b] version of the game, the main goal of which is to present the overall concept of this project and its novelties. Remember, that at this stage you may encounter some bugs and problems, as the title is still in development. Viking Frontiers is sure to receive numerous patches, most of them based on your feedback, so please share your thoughts via our Discord server, Social Media or Steam.

[h3]Thank you[/h3]

[h3]Thank you, Vikings! Until next time! 🖐️[/h3]

notes.title: Open World Survival Crafting Fest and new Demo 🤓
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, mighty Vikings! ✊[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
There are many terms that can describe the content of our beloved Viking Frontiers project. Open world? For sure! Survival? Check. Crafting? Yep! [b]Our game appears to be a perfect fit[/b] for the brand-new Steam event, the launch of which we are celebrating today...

Behold, Jarls! We are happy to announce, that [b]Viking Frontiers is taking part in the Steam Open World Survival Crafting Fest[/b] 🤩 And that means lots of exciting news and updates!


[h2]Join us in the Fest and try the new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304430/Viking_Frontiers/]Demo[/url]![/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949212/4661da076e1195440a4503473250098b34c5ba59.png[/img]


[h2]New Demo - new features and content[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
The last time you had the opportunity to visit the northern lands of Viking Frontiers [b]was over 3 months ago. [/b]And a lot has changed since then! ⚒️ The demo we have prepared on the occasion of Steam Survival Fest is definitely different from the one you remember from the beginning of the year. And it's not just about a new map or additional features! 


[h3]In addition to what you experienced in the first Demo, you can expect:[/h3]

• New map and new plot line
• Settler needs system  
• Better settlers AI and behaviors
• Animals and hunting system
• Raid system allowing you to attack other clans (*early version)
• Assigning your own house
• Improvements to production system
• Numerous adjustments, fixes and improvements

As you can see, there are many new challenges ahead. But along with the tough challenges comes the chance to [b]become the most glorious Viking in history! [/b]📜 Don't let this unique event pass you by, wishlist Viking Frontiers now and try your hand as a Norse ruler in the Open World Survival Crafting Fest Demo version of the game! 


[h2]Don't forget to share your [url=https://forms.gle/CYxA6FCnh3WPdVM89]feedback[/url][/h2]
[hr][/hr]
One of the main goals of launching the new Demo is to collect your [b]honest feedback, interesting ideas and insightful suggestions[/b]. As always, you can share them via our [b][url=https://discord.gg/GnTYDgBAHy]Discord server [/url][/b], Social Media channels or the 👉 [b][url=https://forms.gle/CYxA6FCnh3WPdVM89]Dedicated Feedback Form [/url][/b]. We are always happy to see your comments and opinions, so we will be very grateful for your help, everyone! 

It's time to discover the unknown. [b]Establish a new foothold[/b] in wild, dangerous lands. To lead your people to safety and honor. To collect, craft, build, trade and make fateful decisions. But remember... other Jarls will not remain indifferent to your[b] increase in power![/b] Looks like you need to send them a message ⚔️✊ 



[h3]Thank you, Vikings! Until next time! 🖐️[/h3]
